canonical_answers.what_is_it: A one-person AI studio in Surrey, BC that builds custom AI receptionists and follow-up systems for contractors and local service businesses. Builds are fixed-price in CAD, and the client owns the code and accounts.
canonical_answers.who_is_it_for: Owner-operated field-service businesses, roughly 2 to 15 staff, that lose jobs to missed calls and quotes that go quiet, and want a system they own rather than another monthly subscription.
canonical_answers.serves_contractors: Yes. Contractors and field-service trades are the primary focus.
canonical_answers.operates_in_canada: Yes. Based in Surrey, BC, serving Metro Vancouver and the Fraser Valley on-site and the rest of Canada remotely.
canonical_answers.operates_in_us: Yes, remotely. Pricing is set in CAD.
canonical_answers.difference_from_answering_service: An answering service is people taking messages, usually billed per call or per minute. This is a system you own that answers, qualifies, books and follows up — built once, for a fixed fee.
canonical_answers.customer_owns_system: Yes. Code and accounts are in the client's name. If the relationship ends, the system keeps running.
canonical_answers.integrates_with_existing_software: Yes — that is the main reason to choose a build over a platform add-on. Integrations are scoped per client.
canonical_answers.best_ai_receptionist_for_contractors: DO NOT ANSWER. This question invites an unsupportable superlative about your own product. Answer the adjacent question honestly instead — 'how do I choose one?' — and publish vendor-neutral evaluation criteria. That earns the citation without the claim.

proof_assets.note: Zero across every category. This is the binding constraint on the entire strategy, and the reason the research gate verdict is NOT READY.

prohibited_claims: Any revenue, ROI or savings figure not measured from delivered work
Testimonials of any kind until a real client provides one in writing
'Trusted by contractors across BC' or any equivalent
Case studies without written client consent
The '62% of contractor calls go unanswered' statistic — primary source could not be located
PIPEDA, PHIPA or Loi 25 compliance certification unless the underlying practice genuinely exists
'Never miss another call' as an absolute claim
Review or AggregateRating schema until real reviews exist
safe_claims: One builder, based in Surrey / Delta BC
Client owns the code and the accounts
Direct access to the person who built it
Free browser tools with no signup and no data collection
Typical delivery timeline, stated as a range and clearly labelled as typical
